# Awesome BC250

> A unified EN/RU/UK handbook and thematic project catalog for the ASRock AMD BC250: assembly, power, cooling, Linux, applications, upscalers, macOS experiments, printable models and research. Sources from all platforms are integrated by topic; community messages are evidence, not required instructions.

Repository: https://github.com/kalpakprod/awesome-bc250
Project and handbook integration updated: October 2026. Source dates and revisions are recorded separately; no global completeness or universal hardware-safety claim.

## Important distinctions

- Linux is the primary gaming path; macOS has an experimental MetalCyan configuration with OS/SMBIOS restrictions. Windows driver projects are experimental.
- FSR4's portable DLL continuation is distinct from the original Mesa/RADV work. OptiScaler adapts game interfaces; Client manages installations.
- HelixSR runs DLSS Model E reconstruction through FSR-compatible D3D12 compute; it is not native NVIDIA DLSS support and its upscaler source is unpublished.
- Hardware VCN, compute-based encoding and CPU decoding are different paths. A project title does not prove hardware codec enablement.
- Unlocking a CPU core or WGP does not establish that it is healthy. Board-specific testing, power and cooling remain necessary.
- CAD/STL pages are model sources, not universal fit or thermal guarantees. Historical versions and unfinished projects remain identifiable.
